blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Davao City chief information officer Jefry Tupas has described the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI)’s referral of obstruction of justice, cyber libel, and publication of false news complaints to the Department of Justice (DOJ) against him as “harassment.” In a statement on Wednesday, Tupas said he had earlier presented the NBI with evidence—such as airline ticket bookings, passport photos with stamps, and Facebook posts—that supposedly debunked former police officer Rodulfo Gracioso Jr.’s allegations against him. Gracioso claims he handed over suitcases of money to Tupas for his former boss, Vice President Sara Duterte. READ: NBI recommends obstruction […]...
